#!/bin/bash
MYH=171d959bbeecc8934d18e9fecdb4418e07bc5d4eed30df7a2514236c9154706a
info(){ # $1 label $2 token
 t="$2"; h=$(printf %s "$t" | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)
 code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -H "Authorization: token $t" https://api.github.com/user)
 echo "$1: len=${#t} head=${t:0:4} tail=${t: -4} same_as_new=$([ "$h" = "$MYH" ] && echo YES || echo no) api=$code"
}
echo "--- /root/.git-credentials (masked lines)"
sed -E 's#(://[^:]*:)[^@]{6,}(@)#\1***\2#' /root/.git-credentials | cat -A | cut -c1-120
n=$(wc -l < /root/.git-credentials); echo "lines=$n bytes=$(stat -c %s /root/.git-credentials) perms=$(stat -c %a /root/.git-credentials)"
tok=$(sed -E 's#https://[^:]*:([^@]*)@.*#\1#' /root/.git-credentials | head -1)
info "root cred" "$tok"
info "ubuntu cred" "$(sed -E 's#https://[^:]*:([^@]*)@.*#\1#' /home/ubuntu/.git-credentials | head -1)"
bt=$(cat /etc/vps-github-bridge/token); echo "bridge token file: bytes=$(stat -c %s /etc/vps-github-bridge/token)"
info "bridge file" "$(printf %s "$bt" | tr -d '\r\n ')"
echo "--- bridge script token source"
grep -n -i -E "token|credentials|environ|getenv" /opt/vps-github-bridge/vps_github_bridge.py | sed -E 's/(ghp_|github_pat_)[A-Za-z0-9_]+/\1***/g' | head -15
echo "--- credential fill (what git would use)"
printf 'protocol=https\nhost=github.com\n\n' | GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 HOME=/root git credential fill 2>&1 | sed -E 's/^password=.*/password=<present>/' 
echo "--- other places for tokens"
grep -l -r -E "ghp_|github_pat_" /opt/weather-pipeline/*.sh /opt/weather-pipeline/*.env /etc/vps-github-bridge /root/.config/git /root/.gitconfig 2>/dev/null
echo "--- env of pipeline wrapper"; sed -E 's/(ghp_|github_pat_)[A-Za-z0-9_]+/\1***/g' /opt/weather-pipeline/run_timed.sh | head -30
